Category: Animal.

Style: Bauhaus primary-colour geometry.

spec.name: Songbird on a Branch
spec.description: A stylized songbird with a black cap, red breast disc and blue wings perched on a charcoal branch dressed with primary-coloured leaf discs, in flat Bauhaus geometry.
spec.layout: The model is small and real-world sized: a chunky charcoal branch lies horizontally along X from x=-0.40 to x=+0.40, resting on the floor at its butt end (cut face at x=-0.40) and dipping to the floor at its tapered tip (x=+0.40), centreline about y=0.085, so the perch top at x=0 is y=0.17. The bird stands at the branch centre facing the viewer (+Z), centred on x=0. From front to back: a yellow conical beak at z≈0.13..0.21; a round black-capped head at [0, 0.44, 0.07] with cream cheek discs and big side-set ring eyes; a short blue egg body from y≈0.22 to 0.38 leaning slightly forward, with a bold red breast disc on the chest front, cream belly below and folded blue wing slabs on each flank; black fanned tail feathers rising up-back to about [0, 0.40, -0.26]; two slate legs dropping from the body underside to the branch top with black toes gripping the bark. A forked twig rises from the branch near x=0.26 up to y≈0.30 carrying flat circular leaf discs in yellow, red and blue plus two red berries; the branch wears cream painted ring bands and a growth-ring cut face. Every part is flat-coloured Bauhaus geometry: bold circles, discs and egg/cone primitives in red, blue, yellow, cream and ink on charcoal, with trim as small seated parts (eye rings, wingbar, painted branch rings, leg bands).

parts.builds: The perch and its dressing, all static geometry on the root (list no joints). Build the branch as one low-poly sweep along X: centreline catmull from the butt [-0.40, 0.10, -0.02] through [0, 0.085, -0.02] (gentle sag) to the tip [0.40, 0.05, -0.02], radius tapering 0.10 → 0.05, section with about 8 sides, flat end cap at the butt, colour bark. At the butt end seat a cream lathe disc showing growth rings: cream disc plus three thin ink ring parts inset. Two cream painted band rings wrap the branch (thin swept loops around the tube) at x≈-0.12 and x≈0.20. From the branch top at [0.26, 0.14, -0.02] sprout a forked charcoal twig rising to [0.30, 0.29, -0.10] with one shorter sub-twig; on its tip three flat circular leaf discs (thin cylinders, roughly 0.05 radius, 0.008 thick) angled in different directions: yellow, red and blue, each with a tiny ink stem rod. Two red berry spheres (r≈0.02) hang on short ink stalks from the sub-twig. One flattened cream lichen patch (squashed sphere, r≈0.03) sits on the branch top near x=-0.2, and 2-3 small charcoal bark knot bumps (low spheres) dot the underside.
parts.attaches: Stands on the floor at the butt end (x=-0.40) and at the tapered tip (x=+0.40); the bird's feet grip the perchTop mount [0, 0.17, -0.02].

parts.builds: The torso, wings and tail riding the body and tail joints. Body: a blue egg built as a loft or scaled sphere, centre [0, 0.30, 0], about 0.19 long along Z, 0.15 wide, 0.17 tall, slightly leaning forward (belly down at z≈0.02, shoulders up at z≈-0.04). Belly: a cream lower sweep or a second slightly smaller egg squashed and seated under the front half, reading as pale underside. Breast: the signature detail — a bold flat red disc (thin cylinder, r≈0.055, 0.012 thick) stuck on the chest front at [0, 0.29, 0.075], facing out along +Z and tilted to hug the chest curve, with a thin cream rim ring around it. Neck: a yellow collar band (short swept ring) at the neckSeat mount [0, 0.37, 0.04] where the head part meets the body. Wings, one per side (mirror with s=1/-1): a flat teardrop slab built as an extrude or slab, root at the shoulder [s*0.075, 0.34, -0.01], lying along the flank back to [s*0.06, 0.26, -0.16], blue, with a cream wingbar stripe (small thin box seated across the wing at 60% length) and an ink tip section (small slab over the last 25%); add 2-3 stepped feather notches at the wing tip as small overlapping ink slabs. Tail riding the tail joint: a fan of 5 black feather slabs (extrudes about 0.035 wide, 0.008 thick) spreading ±14 degrees, from the tailRoot mount [0, 0.32, -0.08] up-back to tips around [0, 0.40, -0.26], each with a cream tip cap (small slab at the last 15%). A small cream rump patch sits above the tail root.
parts.attaches: Bottom of the egg overlaps the perch region above hipL/hipR at y≈0.24; the yellow collar band meets the head part at the neckSeat mount [0, 0.37, 0.04]; the tail feathers root at the tailRoot mount [0, 0.32, -0.08].

parts.builds: The head riding the head and jaw joints. Skull: an ink (black) sphere, centre [0, 0.44, 0.07], radius 0.075, about 14x10 segments, smooth. Cheeks: one cream disc per side (flat cylinder, r≈0.042, 0.008 thick) stuck on the head surface at [s*0.055, 0.43, 0.095], facing outward sideways and slightly forward. Eyes on top of the cheeks, one per side: a white ring disc (r≈0.028 with an ink pupil disc r≈0.017 seated in its centre) plus a tiny white glint sphere (r≈0.006) offset up-forward on the pupil; keep the eyes large and readable from the front. A thin cream brow line (small slab) arcs above each eye. Beak riding the jaw joint as two separate pieces so the mouth can open: upper mandible a yellow cone (base r≈0.022, length 0.08) from [0, 0.425, 0.125] pointing +Z and slightly down, with two tiny ink nostril dots near its base; lower mandible a smaller yellow frustum (base r≈0.018, length 0.065) seated just under it at [0, 0.408, 0.125] on the jaw joint, with a thin ink mouth line part between the two. Crown: a small red circular crest dot (r≈0.014 disc) on top of the black cap at [0, 0.515, 0.06] as the single red accent up high.
parts.attaches: Head sphere bottom overlaps the body's yellow collar band at the neckSeat mount [0, 0.37, 0.04]; the beak jaws hang forward over the body's red breast disc.

parts.builds: Legs and feet riding the leg and foot joints, gripping the branch. Per side (mirror with s=1/-1): a slate tarsus rod (r≈0.011, about 6 sides) from the hip mount [s*0.035, 0.24, 0] down to the ankle [s*0.035, 0.19, -0.015], then a short ink foot segment to the perchTop at [s*0.035, 0.165, -0.02]. A yellow birding band (thin cylinder ring, r≈0.014, 0.012 tall) sits on each tarsus at mid-height. Foot riding the foot joint: three forward toes built as small bent capsules or short 2-point sweeps (r≈0.008, length ≈0.045) fanning ±20 degrees around the branch front at z≈-0.02..0.02, each curving down the branch flank and tipped with a tiny ink claw cone; one back toe curls around the branch rear at z≈-0.07. Toes should visibly wrap the branch surface radius (about 0.085 at x=0), toes seated on the bark.
parts.attaches: Hips tuck into the body egg bottom at the hipL/hipR mounts [±0.035, 0.24, 0]; toes grip the branch at the perchTop mount [0, 0.17, -0.02].
